description: 林口區內滯洪設施位置及用地面積 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府水利局. 滯洪池：位於河溪湖泊內、或鄰接處、或支流上開挖出的區域，將地表逕流暫時儲存以收調節洪水功效，降低因為暴雨尖峰流量對下游低勢地區所帶來的傷害。 提供之基本資訊(如：都市計畫用地編號、總集水面積(km2)、地籍面積(m2)、滯洪池使用面積(m2)、現地使用情形) 新增加欄位：公園 / 停車場名稱及位置. Coverage: 新北市政府水利局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府水利局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
